name: Telling Lies
overview: Scripture clearly condemns lying as a serious offense against God and neighbor, commanding believers not to bear false witness (Exodus 20:16) and warning that falsehood leads to punishment and destruction (Proverbs 19:9). God's own nature is truthful and unchanging, contrasting with the deceitfulness of the devil, who is described as the father of lies (Numbers 23:19; John 8:44). The Bible affirms that truthful speech is enduring and pleasing to the Lord, while lying is detestable and fleeting (Proverbs 12:19, 12:22).
